paper_metadata.title: Scalable Vision Language Model Training via High Quality Data Curation
paper_metadata.abstract: In this paper, we introduce SAIL-VL (ScAlable Vision Language Model TraIning via High QuaLity Data Curation), an open-source vision language model (VLM) series achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in 2B and 8B parameters. The following three key improvements contribute to SAIL-VL's leading performance: (1) Scalable high-quality visual understanding data construction: We implement a data construction pipeline to enable hundred-million-scale high-quality recaption data annotation. The resulted dataset SAIL-Caption is validated to be of the highest data quality compared with opensource datasets. (2) Scalable Pretraining with High-Quality Visual Understanding Data: We scale SAIL-VL's pretraining budget up to 655B tokens and show that even a 2B VLM benefits from scaled up training data sizes, exhibiting logarithmic data size scaling laws in benchmark performance. (3) Scalable SFT via data quantity and complexity scaling: We curate a high-quality SFT dataset collection with leading data quantity scaling effectiveness and demonstrate that training with progressively higher-complexity data surpasses baseline one-stage training by a large margin. SAIL-VL series models achieve the highest average score in 18 widely used VLM benchmarks in our evaluation, with the 2B model takes the top position over VLMs of comparable sizes on OpenCompass 2024 (https://rank.opencompass.org.cn/leaderboard-multimodal), demonstrating robust visual comprehension abilities. SAIL-VL series models are released at HuggingFace (https://huggingface.co/BytedanceDouyinContent).

extraction_data.innovation: Scalable caption data construction pipeline (SAIL-Caption): generates a large-scale, high-quality caption dataset to enable large-scale pretraining; improves upon prior VLM training by demonstrating that compact models benefit from scaled-up data size, achieving logarithmic performance gains in visual comprehension as data scales, unlike previous works confined to specific data magnitudes.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: SAIL-Caption (synthesized detail caption and OCR data), Infinity-MM Stage2 data, LLaVA SFT data, Molmo Caption data
extraction_data.research_problem: Scalable Vision Language Model Training via High Quality Data Curation
extraction_data.application: Vision-language interactions, image captioning, visual comprehension, meme understanding
extraction_data.paper_title: Scalable Vision Language Model Training via High Quality Data Curation
extraction_data.finetuning_data: SFT-Knowledge, SFT-Instruction, SFT-Preference, Infinity-MM Stage2, LLaVA SFT, Molmo Caption, custom 12M-sample high-quality visual instruction tuning dataset
extraction_data.hardware_description: 90,053 NPU hours for 2B pretraining, 10,992 for SFT
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pretrain-Alignment (train projector) -> Pretrain-Advance (train vision encoder & projector) -> SFT-Knowledge -> SFT-Instruction -> SFT-Preference (train full model)
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Large-scale recaption data, SAIL-Caption, SAIL-Captioner (InternVL2-8B trained on curated reference data) generates detail captions and alt-texts at scale; dataComp and SA1B subsets used for synthesis
extraction_data.benchmark_result: Average score across 18 benchmarks (no specific values reported); SAIL-Caption HQ: 54.36, 51.80, 55.38; SFT-Instruction: 61.9, 55.8, 67.1, 65.4, 61.7; SFT-Knowledge: 57.8, 53.2, 60.9, 56.9, 63.9; SFT-Preference: 61.3, 57.1, 65.8, 59.5, 61.3
